newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Stg to hover around 2.7780 old ERM floor.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Stg to hover around 2.7780 old ERM floor.

text.p: Sterling climbed back above its old floor in the European exchange rate mechanism at 2.7780 marks in morning trading here but remains in a short-term downtrend from last week's peak at 2.8230, chartists said.

Key support is at 2.7735/30 marks, which held the downside on Monday. That level was a monthly high in March and held the topside until early April before the pound pushed through the old ERM floor to its 4 1/2 year peak at 2.8230 last Tuesday.
"Sterling/mark is in corrective mode, with a risk of extending the downside to 2.76, where it's very well cushioned," said Nick Shamin, currency analyst at Technical Data.
At 0718 GMT the pound traded at 2.7810/20 marks and $1.6331/41 compared with 2.7819/29 and $1.6348/58 in late European trading on Monday.
Shamin said a break through key support at 2.7735 would put the focus on Fibonacci support at 2.7610, a 38.2 percent retracement of the move from 2.6545 to last week's peak above 2.82 marks.
"I'm still bullish in the longer term on sterling/mark," he said. "I see the correction as a good buying opportunity.
Sterling's current woes have been made worse by position-squaring on dollar/mark, analysts said.
Sterling/dollar was testing first resistance at $1.6330/35, a 60-hour moving average, in morning trade, ahead of a firmer barrier at $1.6385/90, the Monday high.
Cable remains trapped in a symmetrical triangle formation between $1.6420 and $1.6620, Standard Chartered technical analyst Andy Hart said in a note to clients.
"Further consolidation within this range seems likely near-term, with another attempt, with another attempt at the high expected to fail," said Hart.
Shamin expects $1.6300 to hold intraday. "Momentum is neutral, and it needs to break $1.6385 to target $1.64,"he said.
RSI - 14 day: Stg/mark: 58 pct, Stg/dollar: 47 pct -- Astrid Zweynert, London forex desk +44 171 542 7792
